d: Imperial fiefdom star systems from Frank Herbert’s Dune Chronicles.

hip-30438.x: Third planet of Canopus; harsh desert world and sole source of the geriatric spice melange in the Known Universe.

gaia-6427464123776727168.x: Oceanic third planet of Delta Pavonis and ancestral fiefdom of House Atreides for twenty-six generations.

gaia-4109030160308317312.x: Industrialised, low-photosynthesis homeworld of House Harkonnen orbiting 36 Ophiuchi B.

canon-dune:kaitain.x: Seat of the Padishah Emperor and House Corrino following the devastation of Salusa Secundus.

b.s: Feudal interstellar empire spanning real navigational stars in Frank Herbert’s Dune appendix and the Dune Encyclopedia, centred on Arrakis (Canopus III), Caladan (Delta Pavonis III), and Giedi Prime (36 Ophiuchi B).
b.r: Dune (Chilton Books, 1965) — Appendix: Terminology of the Imperium
